name: Tute corriente
description: Tute corriente is the oldest two-player form of Tute from Spain. Six cards each, 13th face up for trump, rest as stock. No follow suit until stock is empty; then must follow and beat or trump. First to 101 points or tute (four kings or horses) wins.

content.text: Tute corriente is the oldest two-player form of Tute from Spain. Six cards each, 13th face up for trump, rest as stock. No follow suit until stock is empty; then must follow and beat or trump. First to 101 points or tute (four kings or horses) wins.

Tute corriente is the oldest two-player form of Tute. Tute originated in Italy as tutti, spread to Spain in the 19th century with returning troops, and became one of Spain's most popular card games; the two-player corriente form is the traditional variant described in Spanish card-game literature.
Two players, each playing for themselves; no partnerships.
Six cards each; 13th card face up for trump; rest form stock.
